output.one_liner: An AI-powered customer service platform with collaborative shared inboxes for team email management and client communication.

auth.notes: OAuth 2.0 required for public integrations. API tokens are static personal tokens sent as Bearer authentication.

evidence.snippet: OAuth 2.0 is a protocol that lets external applications request authorization to API access in a secure way.
Front's OAuth implementation only supports the authorization code grant type
Front supports OAuth2.0 as well as API Tokens.

access.notes: Free developer account available to build integrations. API rate limits vary by pricing plan tier (Starter/Professional/Enterprise).

evidence.snippet: Follow the instructions on the Developer Portal to create a free developer account to begin building integrations on the Front Platform.

api_surface.rate_limit_note: Global: 50–200 requests/min depending on plan tier; Burst: 5 requests/sec per resource

evidence.snippet: This repo provides Front Platform API schemas for public consumption. The API schemas conform to the OpenAPI specification.
The API is designed to communicate with your server using JSON.
The Webhooks integration allows you to be automatically notified when something happens in Front without having to constantly poll the API.
Front's default API rate limits vary by pricing plan
Front's MCP server (mcp.frontapp.com/mcp) lets AI agents act on Front conversation data using a single OAuth-authenticated endpoint.
Secure MCP server for Front.com: search conversations, manage contacts, send messages, automate inbox workflows

buildability.rationale: Free developer account, fully documented REST API with OpenAPI specs, webhooks support, and official MCP server all enable immediate toolkit development.

overview_evidence.snippet: Front | Customer service platform, powered by AI
The Core API allows you as a Front developer to access core data and actions within Front.
